dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Oh, you're that Forest Watcher's friend? My apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Eleazar is a very troublesome disease in Sumeru. It makes scale-like objects grow on the patient's body.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: The Bimarstan says that it requires rest... But that patient became a Forest Ranger and is busy all day. Is that really okay?
